description: AlphaZero-style value-to-go for commercial potential. Predicts the BEST commercial-potential score (0-1) an abstract can REACH after a few scientific extensions — its achievable ceiling, not its current score. Trained on self-play rollouts of the Impact Optimizer (ml/selfplay). Used to guide the optimizer's beam by reachable ceiling instead of present value, and as a standalone "commercial headroom" signal (headroom = value_to_go - current).
